overview: Six papers apply ML to survey and simulation data. Euclid DR1 strong-lens work covers vision-transformer segmentation and training/image-processing choices for detection. Other studies use UMAP/k-means on IllustrisTNG, tree ensembles and Gaussian-process emulation to augment FLAMINGO catalogues, deep learning for cluster mass maps from HST imaging, and unsupervised clustering of FAST FRB 20121102A bursts.
